rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0001
rows.name:
The other day I went into town to buy
supplies and happened to run into
Iris.

rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0002
rows.name:
That shoulder grab nearly stopped my
heart. Seems I was mistaken for a
woman, so I played it off, but...

rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Seems he still doesn't
believe I'm dead. Thinks
I'm hiding away somewhere.

rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I said, "Forget someone like that,"
and got yelled at in the street: "You
don't know anything!"

rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Who do you think you're saying that
to? I wanted to say, "I'm right here."
Stupid, right?

rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0006
rows.name:
I think I finally understand what it
means that I can't live as Meknes
anymore.

rows.label: tlk70000073_03_msg0007
rows.name:
Right... I need to think of a new
name. Hah, that's strange. Why am I
crying...?
